title: DCAF15 with indisulam, recruiting RBM39 — the hard case
shows: The same two proteins as 6UD7 with a different ligand, and a different verdict: borderline rather than pass. The ligand lies in a shallow groove rather than a pocket, so it presents 343 square angstroms of broad flat face at 36% buried, and a face like that restrains a docking search weakly -- many wrong placements cover it. Included on purpose. A tool worth trusting has to be seen saying "not sure", and the pair with 6UD7 shows the verdict following the chemistry rather than the proteins.
